row.notes: Fully read; fills the UI VM detail panel for one tyre set (record stride 0x6c: +0x0 owner/driver id, +0x4 compound id, +0x8 set index byte, +0x9 flags bit0=unused/new, bit2=mandatory, bit3=other state, +0xc/+0x18/+0x24/+0x30 four per-wheel wear floats, +0x14/+0x20/+0x2c/+0x38 per-wheel used bytes). Looks up compound id in the 0x18-stride table at 0x146082400 (count 0x146082478, fallback id 1 or 4) and writes title, description, then under child nodes of sel+0x90: availability (lng_recommended_for / lng_reserved_for with name from FUN_14211f980, or fixed lng keys by flags and Car_Tyre_IsCompoundAllowed), compound_texture, is_mandatory, is_fastest_q2_tyre (sel+0x30 record: +4 compound, +8 set index), info_text (lng_mandatory_set / lng_q2_fastest_lap), is_info_text_visible, set_number_string (set index+1 of group count from compoundGroup +0x10..+0x18); three stat nodes each with value_text, value_text_colour and a float bar value: condition percent = clamp(avg of 4 wear floats - 0.0001, 0..1), 1.0 if bit0 set; laps via FUN_141f99e50 / FUN_141f9a080 on sel+0x28 with min_text, max_text and bar 1 - a/b; lap time delta vs equippedSet via FUN_141facce0 * 1000 coloured red if positive, green if negative, white if abs < 0.0005, or a placeholder when either set has bit0. No return value used. Good hook to change what the tyre panel shows; the delta and lap helpers are the places to change the numbers. Context from caller: called by Game_GarageTabletTyreSelectVM_BuildNodes right after it builds the 0xa8 selection object and subscribes FUN_141faf1f0; the batch line listed caller not identified, xref found by grep at 141faa0f0.c line 326.
